name: Azeroth Companion
title: ATLAS DISCOVERY — Cross-Zone Search & Map-Integrated Research
approval_note: Requested search-first dungeon, raid, loot and farming usability without adding panels. Real data and actual-device acceptance pending, no fictional loot claims.
features: Cross-zone search of existing source-curated markers inside the map sidebar, including geographic match and category filter.
In-map destination selection retains coordinate copying, original map zoom and pan, source credit and image fallback.
Activity chips expose dungeons, raids, delves, gathering markers, travel nodes and places without separate panels.
Gear, bosses, loot and farming research open an explicitly external searchable Wowhead database; no fabricated drop tables or unverified farming paths.
No new browser storage keys, worker or authentication changes; prior Atlas records remain intact.
